paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools across two categories of text data. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis," displays two discrete groups ordered from left to right: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet." The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with major tick marks and dash-dot grid lines spaced at intervals of 0.2. Within each category on the horizontal axis, bars are clustered in groups of three to represent the different tools, as indicated by a legend in the bottom right corner. The leftmost bar in each group represents "TEXTBLOB" and features a white fill with a solid black outline; it records an approximate value of 0.33 for Emoji Tweets—the shortest bar in the chart—and 0.40 for Overall Tweet. The middle bar represents "VADER," distinguished by a white fill with diagonal black hatching and a black outline, with approximate values of 0.46 for Emoji Tweets and 0.47 for Overall Tweet. The rightmost bar in each group represents "ChatGPT" and is shaded solid green without an outline, showing approximate values of 0.67 for Emoji Tweets—the tallest bar in the chart—and 0.66 for Overall Tweet. The bars are not sorted by height, but strictly follow the sequential order of TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT within both horizontal categories.
